whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake (#164).
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH counts the voice note and celebrates bars 1 to 4 holding up hands together. It's curious about bar 5 and hears that the left-hand jump feels too far and he panics before it. Since the recording shows bars 5 to 8 aren't there yet, the next step doesn't move up (no bars 9 to 16 yet): it's another try at the same passage, with help aimed at the jump (for example practicing just the jump on its own, eyes on the landing note, or bar 5 slower than the rest before playing 1 to 8). Warm, no blame, fully defined, asked if it works. After 'ok yeah' a short confirmation.
facts: bars 1 to 4 felt steady hands together
at bar 5 the left hand has to jump down, and right before it you look down at your left hand and lose your place
you don't speed up; you tense a little only after you've missed
15 minutes at 7 pm at the keyboard works again tomorrow
